title: Real review
body: Used this to better my life no subscription love it
author: jk fybn

title: Loving it so far!
body:
Was looking for a simple habit tracker just like this. One thing I'd love to have added is a way to add notes to each days habit so you can jot down specifically what you did and how you managed it! 

The biggest thing to me is that they collect no personal data from you which in most free apps is the caveat. 

Thank you so much for making and maintaining this Alexander!
author: JC Jenkins

title: Simple and perfect
body: I’ve been waiting for years for an app like this. Unlike most of the other ridiculously, unnecessarily complicated apps out there, this one is simple, easily customizable, and it works.
author: ClassicallyTrained

title: Awesome habit building app in its earliest form
body:
Awesome app with a lot of potential! A couple recommendations:

1. Make it more clear what days your habits are set for on the main page. The reminders are great, but being able to easily see the days the reminders go off would be helpful. 

2. I LOVE the inspirational quotes, but I think it would be super cool if that feature happened automatically. Maybe every time the screen refreshed, you could have it display, instead of on tap?
